name: Aberrant Dragonmark
description: +1 Constitution, gain a cantrip and 1st level spell Buff, Debuff Prerequisite: No other dragonmark You have manifested an aberrant dragonmark. Determine its appearance and the flaw associated with it. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn a cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list. In addition, choose a 1st-level spell from the sorcerer spell list. You learn that spell and can cast it through your mark. Once you cast it, you must finish a short or long rest before you can cast it again through the mark. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells. When you cast the 1st-level spell through your mark, you can expend one of your Hit Dice and roll it. If you roll an even number, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the number rolled. If you roll an odd number, one random creature within 30 feet of you (not including you) takes force damage equal to the number rolled. If no other creatures are in range, you take the damage. You also develop a random flaw from the Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws table. Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws OPTION: GREATER ABERRANT POWERS At the DM’s option, a character who has the Aberrant Dragonmark feat has a chance of manifesting greater power. Upon reaching 10th level, such a character has a 10 percent chance of gaining an epic boon from among the options in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master’s Guide. If the character fails to gain a boon, they have a 10 percent chance the next time they gain a level. If the character gains a boon, the DM chooses it or determines it randomly. The character also permanently loses one of their Hit Dice, and their hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to a roll of that die plus their Constitution modifier (minimum reduction of 1). This reduction can’t be reversed by any means.

name: Actor
prerequisite: 4th Level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Lunitari) Feat
description: +1 Charisma, skilled at mimicry and dramatics Buff, Social, Deception Adept of the Black Robes

name: Alert
description: +5 Initiative, can't be surprised, no advantage for hidden attackers Buff, Detection Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits: You gain a +5 bonus to initiative. You can't be surprised while you are conscious. Other creatures don’t gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being unseen by you.

name: Athlete
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity - you have undergone extensive physical training Buff, Movement, Exploration You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you are prone, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement. Climbing doesn't cost you extra movement. You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

name: Charger
description: Make a melee attack or shove after the Dash action Movement, Combat When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack or to shove a creature. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before taking this bonus action, you either gain a +5 bonus to the attack’s damage roll (if you chose to make a melee attack and hit) or push the target up to 10 feet away from you (if you chose to shove and you succeed).

name: Chef
description: +1 Constitution or Wisdom, Cook's Utensils proficiency, cook special food Healing, Buff Time spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off , granting you the following benefits: Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with cook’s utensils if you don’t already have it. As part of a short rest, you can cook special food, provided you have ingredients and cook’s utensils on hand. You can prepare enough of this food for a number of creatures equal to 4 + your proficiency bonus. At the end of the short rest, any creature who eats the food and spends one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points regains an extra 1d8 hit points. With one hour of work or when you finish a long rest, you can cook a number of treats equal to your proficiency bonus. These special treats last 8 hours after being made. A creature can use a bonus action to eat one of those treats to gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

name: Crossbow Expert
description: No loading, no within 5 ft. disadvantage, bonus action attack with hand crossbow Thanks to extensive practice with the crossbow, you gain the following benefits: You ignore the loading property of crossbows with which you are proficient. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn’t impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls. When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a hand crossbow you are holding.

name: Defensive Duelist
description: Add your proficiency bonus to your AC as a reaction Combat, Warding Prerequisite: Dexterity 13 or higher When you are wielding a finesse weapon with which you are proficient and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

name: Dual Wielder
description: +1 AC bonus, wield heavier weapons, draw or stow two weapons at once Buff, Combat You master fighting with two weapons, gaining the following benefits: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand. You can use two-weapon fighting even when the one-handed melee weapons you are wielding aren't light. You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

name: Dungeon Delver
description: You are alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons Buff, Detection, Warding Alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons, you gain the following benefits: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to detect the presence of secret doors. You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid or resist traps. You have resistance to the damage dealt by traps. Traveling at a fast pace doesn't impose the normal −5 penalty on your passive Wisdom (Perception) score.

name: Durable
description: +1 Constitution, minimum Con modifier x2 on spent Hit Dice Healing, Buff Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points you regain from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

name: Elemental Adept
prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
description: Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type Damage, Control Prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2. You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

name: Fey Touched
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, learn misty step and another 1st level spell Buff, Utility Your exposure to the Feywild’s magic has changed you, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn the misty step spell and one 1st-level spell of your choice. The 1st-level spell must be from the divination or enchantment school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can’t cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Grappler
description: You’ve developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling. You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage Damage, Combat You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following benefits: On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action. Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

name: Healer
description: You are an able physician, allowing you to mend wounds quickly and get your allies back in the fight. You gain the following benefits: When you use a healer's kit to stabilize a dying creature, that creature also regains 1 hit point. As an action, you can spend one use of a healer's kit to tend to a creature and restore 1d6 + 4 hit points to it, plus additional hit points equal to the creature's maximum number of Hit Dice. The creature can't regain hit points from this feat again until it finishes a short or long rest.

name: Heavily Armored
description: You have trained to master the use of heavy armor, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

name: Heavy Armor Master
description: +1 Strength, damage reduction from nonmagical weapons Buff, Warding Prerequisite: Proficiency with heavy armor You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. While you are wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 3.

name: Inspiring Leader
description: Inspire your companions to grant temporary hit points Healing, Buff, Social Prerequisite: Charisma 13 or higher You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions, shoring up their resolve to fight. When you do so, choose up to six friendly creatures (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you and who can understand you. Each creature can gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Charisma modifier. A creature can't gain temporary hit points from this feat again until it has finished a short or long rest.

name: Keen Mind
description: +1 Intelligence, track time, direction, and detail with uncanny precision Buff, Utility, Exploration You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail with uncanny precision. You gain the following benefits. Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You always know which way is north. You always know the number of hours left before the next sunrise or sunset. You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.

name: Lightly Armored
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity, proficiency with light armor Buff, Warding You have trained to master the use of light armor, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with light armor.

name: Linguist
description: +1 Intelligence, additional languages, create written ciphers Buff, Utility You have studied languages and codes, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn three languages of your choice. You can ably create written ciphers. Others can't decipher a code you create unless you teach them, they succeed on an Intelligence check (DC equal to your Intelligence score + your proficiency bonus), or they use magic to decipher it.

name: Lucky
description: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment. You have 3 luck points. Whenever you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can spend one luck point to roll an additional d20. You can choose to spend one of your luck points after you roll the die, but before the outcome is determined. You choose which of the d20s is used for the attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. You can also spend one luck point when an attack roll is made against you. Roll a d20, and then choose whether the attack uses the attacker's roll or yours. If more than one creature spends a luck point to influence the outcome of a roll, the points cancel each other out; no additional dice are rolled. You regain your expended luck points when you finish a long rest.

name: Mage Slayer
description: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters Buff, Debuff, Combat You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters, gaining the following benefits: When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature. When you damage a creature that is concentrating on a spell, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain its concentration. You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.

name: Magic Initiate
description: Learn basic spells from a chosen class Buff, Utility Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class’s spell list. In addition, choose one 1st-level spell to learn from that same list. Using this feat, you can cast the spell once at its lowest level, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. Your spellcasting ability for these spells depends on the class you chose: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; or Intelligence for wizard.

name: Martial Adept
description: You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers. You gain the following benefits: You learn two maneuvers of your choice from among those available to the Battle Master archetype in the fighter class. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice). You gain one superiority die, which is a d6 (this die is added to any superiority dice you have from another source). This die is used to fuel your maneuvers. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

name: Medium Armor Master
description: You have practiced moving in medium armor Buff, Warding Prerequisite: Proficiency with medium armor You have practiced moving in medium armor to gain the following benefits: Wearing medium armor doesn't impose disadvantage on your Dexterity (Stealth) checks. When you wear medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity of 16 or higher.

name: Mobile
description: You are exceptionally speedy and agile. You gain the following benefits: Your speed increases by 10 feet. When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn. When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn, whether you hit or not.

name: Moderately Armored
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity, proficiency with medium armor and shields Buff, Warding Prerequisite: Proficiency with light armor You have trained to master the use of medium armor and shields, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

name: Mounted Combatant
description: You are a dangerous foe to face while mounted Buff, Warding You are a dangerous foe to face while mounted. While you are mounted and aren't incapacitated, you gain the following benefits: You have advantage on melee attack rolls against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount. You can force an attack targeted at your mount to target you instead. If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

name: Observant
description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom, quick to notice details of your environment Buff, Detection Quick to notice details of your environment, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. If you can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can interpret what it's saying by reading its lips. You have a +5 bonus to your passive Wisdom (Perception) and passive Intelligence (Investigation) scores.

name: Piercer
description: +1 Strength, or Dexterity, reroll damage dice for piercing damage You have achieved a penetrating precision in combat, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals piercing damage, you can reroll one of the attack’s damage dice, and you must use the new roll. When you score a critical hit that deals piercing damage to a creature, you can roll one additional damage die when determining the extra piercing damage the target takes.

name: Poisoner
description: Learn to make and use poisons in combat Buff, Combat You can prepare and deliver deadly poisons, granting you the following benefits: When you make a damage roll that deals poison damage, it ignores resistance to poison damage. You can apply poison to a weapon or piece of ammunition as a bonus action, instead of an action. You gain proficiency with the Poisoner's Kit if you don’t already have it. With one hour of work using a poisoner’s kit and expending 50 gp worth of materials, you can create a number of doses of potent poison equal to your proficiency bonus. Once applied to a weapon or piece of ammunition, the poison retains its potency for 1 minute or until you hit with the weapon or ammunition. When a creature takes damage from the coated weapon or ammunition, that creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 2d8 poison damage and become poisoned until the end of your next turn.

name: Polearm Master
description: You can keep your enemies at bay with reach weapons Control, Combat You gain the following benefits: When you take the Attack action and attack with only a glaive, halberd, quarterstaff, or spear, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. This attack uses the same ability modifier as the primary attack. The weapon’s damage die for this attack is a d4, and it deals bludgeoning damage. While you are wielding a glaive, halberd, pike, quarterstaff, or spear, other creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they enter the reach you have with that weapon.

name: Resilient
description: +1 stat and proficiency with saving throws to a chosen ability score Buff, Warding Choose one ability score. You gain the following benefits: Increase the chosen ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in saving throws using the chosen ability.

name: Ritual Caster
prerequisite: Intelligence or Wisdom of 13 or higher
description: You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals Prerequisite: Intelligence or Wisdom of 13 or higher You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals. These spells are written in a ritual book, which you must have in hand while casting one of them. When you choose this feat, you acquire a ritual book holding two 1st-level spells of your choice. Choose one of the following classes: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. You must choose your spells from that class’s spell list, and the spells you choose must have the ritual tag. The class you choose also determines your spellcasting ability for these spells: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; or Intelligence for wizard. If you come across a spell in written form, such as a magical spell scroll or a wizard’s spellbook, you might be able to add it to your ritual book. The spell must be on the spell list for the class you chose, the spell’s level can be no higher than half your level (rounded up), and it must have the ritual tag. The process of copying the spell into your ritual book takes 2 hours per level of the spell, and costs 50 gp per level. The cost represents material components you expend as you experiment with the spell to master it, as well as the fine inks you need to record it.

name: Savage Attacker
description: Reroll damage dice for melee weapon attacks Damage, Combat Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon’s damage dice and use either total.

name: Sentinel
description: Take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard Control, Warding You have mastered techniques to take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard, gaining the following benefits: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn. Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they take the Disengage action before leaving your reach. When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a target other than you (and that target doesn't have this feat), you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the attacking creature.

name: Shadow Touched
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, learn invisibility and another 1st level spell Buff, Utility Your exposure to the Shadowfell’s magic has changed you, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn the invisibility spell and one 1st-level spell of your choice. The 1st-level spell must be from the illusion or necromancy school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can’t cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Ranged weapons mastery - make shots that others find impossible Damage, Buff You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible. You gain the following benefits: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls. Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. Before you make an attack with a ranged weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

name: Shield Master
description: Use shields not just for protection but also for offense Damage, Combat, Warding You use shields not just for protection but also for offense. You gain the following benefits while you are wielding a shield: If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to try to shove a creature within 5 feet of you with your shield. If you aren't incapacitated, you can add your shield's AC bonus to any Dexterity saving throw you make against a spell or other harmful effect that targets only you. If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can use your reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, interposing your shield between yourself and the source of the effect.

name: Skill Expert
description: +1 to an ability score, +1 proficiency, expertise You have honed your proficiency with particular skills, granting you the following benefits: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Choose one skill in which you have proficiency. You gain expertise with that skill, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with it. The skill you choose must be one that isn’t already benefiting from a feature, such as Expertise, that doubles your proficiency bonus.

name: Skilled
description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Skulker
description: You are expert at slinking through shadows Buff, Deception Prerequisite: Dexterity 13 or higher You are expert at slinking through shadows. You gain the following benefits: You can try to hide when you are lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding. When you are hidden from a creature and miss it with a ranged weapon attack, making the attack doesn't reveal your position. Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.

name: Slasher
description: +1 Strength, or Dexterity, wound and disable targets with bladed weapons Buff, Combat You’ve learned where to cut to have the greatest results, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals slashing damage, you can reduce the speed of the target by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. When you score a critical hit that deals slashing damage to a creature, you grievously wound it. Until the start of your next turn, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls.

name: Spell Sniper
prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
description: Enhance your attacks with certain kinds of spells Buff, Combat Prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell You have learned techniques to enhance your attacks with certain kinds of spells, gaining the following benefits: When you cast a spell that requires you to make an attack roll, the spell’s range is doubled. Your ranged spell attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. You learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll. Choose the cantrip from the bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. Your spellcasting ability for this cantrip depends on the spell list you chose from: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; or Intelligence for wizard.

name: Svirfneblin Magic
description: Inherit the innate spellcasting ability of your ancestors Deception, Warding, Species Feat Prerequisite: Gnome (deep gnome) You have inherited the innate spellcasting ability of your ancestors. This ability allows you to cast nondetection on yourself at will, without needing a material component. You can also cast each of the following spells once with this ability: blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self. You regain the ability to cast these spells when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells, and you cast them at their lowest possible levels.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: +1 Strength or Constitution, improved improvised weapons Damage, Utility, Combat Accustomed to rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons happen to be at hand, you gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You are proficient with improvised weapons. Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or an improvised weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.

name: Telekinetic
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, learn mage hand, and move things with your mind. Control You learn to move things with your mind, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn the mage hand cantrip. You can cast it without verbal or somatic components, and you can make the spectral hand invisible. If you already know this spell, its range increases by 30 feet when you cast it. Its spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. As a bonus action, you can try to telekinetically shove one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do so, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat) or be moved 5 feet toward you or away from you. A creature can willingly fail this save.

name: Telepathic
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Telepathy 60 ft. Communication, Psionic You awaken the ability to mentally connect with others, granting you the following benefits: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. Your communication doesn’t give the creature the ability to respond to you telepathically. You can cast the detect thoughts spell, requiring no spell slot or components, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it this way again. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat. If you have spell slots of 2nd level or higher, you can cast this spell with them.

name: Tough
description: Gain +2 hit points per character level Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.

name: War Caster
prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat Combat, Warding Prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration on a spell when you take damage. You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a shield in one or both hands. When a hostile creature's movement provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to cast a spell at the creature, rather than making an opportunity attack. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action and must target only that creature.

name: Weapon Master
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity, 4 additional weapon proficiencies Buff, Combat You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice. Each one must be a simple or a martial weapon.

name: Bountiful Luck
description: Reaction when an ally you can see within 30 feet rolls a 1 on an attack, check or save: it rerolls and must use the new roll. You can't use Lucky until the end of your next turn.

name: Dragon Fear
description: +1 Str, Con or Cha. Spend a Breath Weapon use to roar instead: chosen creatures within 30 feet that can see or hear you make a Wis save (DC 8 + proficiency + Cha) or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save when they take damage.

name: Dragon Hide
description: +1 Str, Con or Cha. Unarmored AC 13 + Dex (shields allowed). Retractable claws: unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + Str slashing.

name: Drow High Magic
description: Detect magic at will; levitate and dispel magic once each per long rest without a slot. Charisma is the spellcasting ability.

name: Dwarven Fortitude
description: +1 Con. When you take the Dodge action in combat, spend a Hit Die to heal its roll + Con mod (min 1).

name: Elven Accuracy
description: +1 Dex, Int, Wis or Cha. With advantage on an attack using Dex, Int, Wis or Cha, reroll one of the dice once.

name: Fade Away
description: +1 Dex or Int. Reaction right after taking damage: invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage or force a save. Once per short or long rest.

name: Fey Teleportation
description: +1 Int or Cha. Speak, read and write Sylvan. Misty step once per short or long rest without a slot (Intelligence).

name: Flames of Phlegethos
description: +1 Int or Cha. Reroll 1s on your spells' fire damage dice (must keep the reroll). After casting a fire spell, flames wreathe you until the end of your next turn: bright light 30 feet, dim 30 more, and a creature within 5 feet that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d4 fire.

name: Infernal Constitution
description: +1 Con. Resistance to cold and poison damage; advantage on saves against being poisoned.

name: Orcish Fury
description: +1 Str or Con. Once per short or long rest, on a simple or martial weapon hit, roll one weapon damage die again and add it. Right after Relentless Endurance, reaction to make one weapon attack.

name: Prodigy
description: One skill, one tool and one language of your choice, plus expertise in one skill you're proficient in that isn't already doubled.

name: Second Chance
description: +1 Dex, Con or Cha. Reaction when a creature you can see hits you with an attack: it rerolls. Usable again after you roll initiative or finish a short or long rest.

name: Squat Nimbleness
description: +1 Str or Dex. +5 feet walking speed. Proficiency in Acrobatics or Athletics. Advantage on Athletics or Acrobatics checks to escape a grapple.

name: Wood Elf Magic
description: One druid cantrip of your choice; longstrider and pass without trace once each per long rest without a slot. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability.

name: Artificer Initiate
description: One artificer cantrip and one 1st-level artificer spell (Intelligence); cast the 1st-level spell once per long rest without a slot or with your slots. Proficiency with one artisan's tool, usable as a focus for your Intelligence spells.

name: Eldritch Adept
description: Learn one Eldritch Invocation (Int, Wis or Cha, chosen now); one with a prerequisite only if you're a warlock who meets it. Swap it when you gain a level.

name: Fighting Initiate
description: Learn one fighter Fighting Style you don't have; swap it at levels that grant an Ability Score Improvement.

name: Gunner
description: +1 Dex. Proficiency with firearms, ignore their loading property, and no disadvantage on ranged attacks for being within 5 feet of a hostile creature.

name: Metamagic Adept
description: Learn two sorcerer Metamagic options (one per spell unless an option says otherwise; swap one at Ability Score Improvement levels) and 2 sorcery points usable only on Metamagic, regained on a long rest.

name: Revenant Blade
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 20). While wielding a double-bladed scimitar with two hands, +1 AC, and it has the finesse property for you.
book: Eberron: Rising from the Last War

name: Anvilwrought
description: Forged by Purphoros. Constructed Resilience: advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison; no need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep; immune to disease; magic can't put you to sleep. Sentry's Rest: a long rest is 6 hours motionless but aware.

name: Heroic Destiny
description: Defy Death: advantage on death saving throws. Hard to Kill: once per long rest, when reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead.

name: Iconoclast
description: Enlightened Protection: cast protection from evil and good on yourself once per long rest without material components (Wisdom). Reject the Gods: you can't gain or lose piety. At 5th level cast dispel magic once per long rest; at 11th dispel evil and good once per long rest and dispel magic at 4th level; at 17th antimagic field once per long rest and dispel magic at 5th level.

name: Inscrutable
description: Psychic Shield: resistance to psychic damage. Sphinx's Shroud: immune to effects that sense your emotions or read your thoughts; Insight checks to read your intentions have disadvantage.

name: Lifelong Companion
description: Boon Aura: allies within 5 feet have advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed while you aren't incapacitated. Companion's Protection: once per long rest, reaction when a creature you can see within 5 feet is hit by an attack roll to be hit instead.

name: Nyxborn
description: Cloak of Stars: once per long rest, action to wrap yourself in starlight for 1 minute, giving attack rolls against you disadvantage. Nyxborn Resistance: resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.

name: Oracle
description: Ears of the Oracle: speak, read and write Celestial, and a god can speak through you. Oracle's Insight: once per short or long rest add 1d10 to an ability check (after rolling, before the result). Instead of a god's piety benefits: piety 3+ augury as a ritual, 10+ divination as a ritual, 25+ commune as a ritual and can't be surprised, each once per long rest (Wisdom); 50+ +2 Intelligence or Wisdom and that maximum.

name: Pious
description: Pious Protection: once per long rest, reroll a failed save and use the new roll. Religious Study: advantage on Religion checks about your god. Starting Piety: 3 with your chosen god.

name: Unscarred
description: Unscarred Resilience: once per short or long rest, reaction when you take damage to reduce it by 1d12 + your Constitution modifier.

name: Strixhaven Initiate
description: Choose a Strixhaven college; learn two of its cantrips and one 1st-level spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots (Int, Wis or Cha). Lorehold: two of light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy, plus a 1st-level cleric or wizard spell. Prismari: two of fire bolt, prestidigitation, ray of frost, plus a 1st-level bard or sorcerer spell. Quandrix: two of druidcraft, guidance, mage hand, plus a 1st-level druid or wizard spell. Silverquill: two of sacred flame, thaumaturgy, vicious mockery, plus a 1st-level bard or cleric spell. Witherbloom: two of chill touch, druidcraft, spare the dying, plus a 1st-level druid or wizard spell.

name: Strixhaven Mascot
description: Cast find familiar as a ritual, with your college's mascot as a form (spirit statue, art elemental, fractal, inkling or pest). When you Attack, forgo one attack to let it attack with its reaction. Action: swap places with it within 60 feet, once per long rest or by spending a 2nd-level or higher slot.

name: Divinely Favored
description: Learn one cleric cantrip, augury, and one 1st-level spell set by your alignment: a warlock spell if evil, a cleric spell if good, a druid spell if neutral. Cast augury and the 1st-level spell once each per long rest without a slot, or with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the spellcasting ability (chosen with this feat), and you can use a holy symbol as a focus for spells using it.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Initiate of High Sorcery
prerequisite: Dragonlance Campaign, Sorcerer or Wizard class or Mage of High Sorcery background
description: Choose a moon of Krynn. Learn one wizard cantrip and two 1st-level spells from its list. Nuitari: dissonant whispers, false life, hex, ray of sickness. Lunitari: color spray, disguise self, feather fall, longstrider. Solinari: comprehend languages, detect evil and good, protection from evil and good, shield. Cast each 1st-level spell once per long rest without a slot, or with any slots. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the spellcasting ability (chosen with this feat).
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Adept of the Black Robes
prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Nuitari) feat
description: Ambitious Magic: learn one 2nd-level enchantment or necromancy spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Life Channel: when a creature you can see within 60 feet fails a save against a damaging spell you cast, spend Hit Dice equal to the spell's level, roll them, and add the total to its damage.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Adept of the Red Robes
prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Lunitari) feat
description: Insightful Magic: learn one 2nd-level illusion or transmutation spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Magical Balance: when you roll 9 or lower on the d20 for an attack roll or ability check, treat it as a 10; proficiency bonus times per long rest.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Adept of the White Robes
prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Solinari) feat
description: Protective Magic: learn one 2nd-level abjuration or divination spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Protective Ward: when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction and expend a spell slot to reduce the damage by d6s equal to the slot's level plus your spellcasting modifier.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Squire of Solamnia
prerequisite: Dragonlance Campaign, Fighter or Paladin class or Knight of Solamnia background
description: Mount Up: mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement. Precise Strike: once per turn, give a weapon attack roll against a creature advantage; on a hit add 1d8 to the damage. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest, spent only on a hit.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Knight of the Crown
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity or Constitution (max 20). Commanding Rally: as a bonus action, an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you can make one weapon attack with its reaction, adding 1d8 damage on a hit; proficiency bonus times per long rest. Knights of Solamnia belong to one order at a time but keep every Knight of Solamnia feat they have gained if they change orders.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Knight of the Rose
description: +1 Constitution, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Bolstering Rally: as a bonus action, a creature you can see within 30 feet (you included) that can see or hear you gains temporary HP equal to 1d8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the score this feat raised; proficiency bonus times per long rest. Knights of Solamnia belong to one order at a time but keep every Knight of Solamnia feat they have gained if they change orders.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Knight of the Sword
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Demoralizing Strike: once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, it makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the modifier of the score this feat raised) or is frightened of you until the end of your next turn; on a success it has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest. Knights of Solamnia belong to one order at a time but keep every Knight of Solamnia feat they have gained if they change orders.
book: Dragonlance: Shadow of the Dragon Queen

name: Scion of the Outer Planes
description: Choose a plane type for a damage resistance and a cantrip (cast without material components; Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma chosen with this feat). Chaotic: poison, minor illusion. Evil: necrotic, chill touch. Good: radiant, sacred flame. Lawful: force, guidance. The Outlands: psychic, mage hand.

name: Agent of Order
prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Lawful) feat
description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Stasis Strike: once per turn when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet, deal an extra 1d8 force and it makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + your Scion spellcasting modifier) or is restrained until the start of your next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

name: Baleful Scion
prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Evil) feat
description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Grasp of Avarice: once per turn when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet, deal an extra 1d6 + proficiency bonus necrotic and regain that many HP. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

name: Cohort of Chaos
prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Chaotic) feat
description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Chaotic Flare: when you roll a 1 or 20 on an attack roll or save, roll a d4 for a flare lasting until the end of your next turn (one at a time). 1 Battle Fury: a creature you can see has advantage on attacks and disadvantage on ability checks. 2 Disruption Field: creatures starting their turn within 5 feet of you or first entering that area on a turn take 1d8 force. 3 Unbound: you can spend movement to teleport that far to an unoccupied space you can see, once. 4 Wailing Winds: creatures within 15 feet of you, you included, have disadvantage on Wisdom saves.

name: Outlands Envoy
prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (The Outlands) feat
description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Crossroads Emissary: learn misty step and tongues; cast each once per long rest without a slot (tongues needs no material components), or with slots, using your Scion spellcasting ability.

name: Planar Wanderer
prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes feat
description: Planar Adaptation: after each long rest, choose resistance to acid, cold or fire until your next long rest. Portal Cracker: as an action, concentrate on a portal within 5 feet and make a DC 20 Int (Arcana) check; on a success force it open or closed for 1 hour (its key works only with a DC 20 Int (Arcana) check as an action), on a failure take 3d8 psychic and can't try that portal again until a long rest. Portal Sense: you know the direction to the last portal you used on the same plane, and once per long rest, as an action, detect portals within 30 feet not behind total cover.

name: Righteous Heritor
prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Good) feat
description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Soothe Pain: when you or a creature within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to reduce it by 1d10 + proficiency bonus. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

name: Rune Shaper
prerequisite: Spellcasting feature or Rune Carver background
description: Learn comprehend languages; cast it once per long rest without a slot, or with any slots. Rune Magic: you know runes equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down). After each long rest, inscribe each on a nonmagical object you touch and know its 1st-level spell until your next long rest; while carrying a marked object, cast that spell with your slots, or once per long rest per rune without a slot or material components. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the ability (chosen with this feat). Swap one rune each level. Runes: Cloud fog cloud, Death inflict wounds, Dragon chromatic orb, Enemy disguise self, Fire burning hands, Friend speak with animals, Frost armor of Agathys, Hill goodberry, Journey longstrider, King command, Mountain entangle, Stone sanctuary, Storm thunderwave.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Strike of the Giants
prerequisite: Martial weapon proficiency or Giant Foundling background
description: Choose one strike. Once per turn when you hit with a melee or thrown weapon attack, add its effect (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Str or Con modifier); proficiency bonus uses per long rest. Cloud: +1d4 thunder, and on a failed Wis save you are invisible to the creature until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast. Fire: +1d10 fire. Frost: +1d6 cold, and on a failed Con save its speed is 0 until the start of your next turn. Hill: +1d6 of the weapon's type, and on a failed Str save it falls prone. Stone: +1d6 force, and on a failed Str save it is pushed 10 feet. Storm: +1d6 lightning, and on a failed Con save it has disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Ember of the Fire Giant
prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Fire Strike) feat
description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Born of Flame: resistance to fire. Searing Ignition: once per turn, replace one attack of your Attack action with a 15-foot burst: chosen creatures make a Dex save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier), taking 1d8 + proficiency bonus fire and blinded until the start of your next turn, or half damage only on a success. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Fury of the Frost Giant
prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Frost Strike) feat
description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Born of Ice: resistance to cold. Frigid Retaliation: right after a creature you can see within 30 feet hits and damages you, use your reaction to force a Con save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier); on a failure it takes 1d8 + proficiency bonus cold and has speed 0 until the end of its next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Guile of the Cloud Giant
prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Cloud Strike) feat
description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Charisma (max 20). Cloudy Escape: when a creature you can see hits you with an attack, use your reaction to resist its damage, then teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Keenness of the Stone Giant
prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Stone Strike) feat
description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Cavernous Sight: darkvision 60 feet, or +60 feet to existing darkvision. Stone Throw: as a bonus action, make a ranged spell attack with a rock (range 60 feet, using the raised ability): 1d10 force, and the target makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + that modifier) or falls prone. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Soul of the Storm Giant
prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Storm Strike) feat
description: +1 Strength, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Maelstrom Aura: as a bonus action, a 10-foot aura surrounds you until the start of your next turn (or until incapacitated): you resist lightning and thunder, attacks against you have disadvantage, and a creature starting its turn in it can be forced to make a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier) or have half speed until the start of its next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Vigor of the Hill Giant
prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Hill Strike) feat
description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Bulwark: when an effect would move you 5 feet or more or knock you prone, use your reaction to stay put and standing. Iron Stomach: when you eat during a short rest and spend Hit Dice, regain extra HP equal to your Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus.
book: Bigby Presents: Glory of the Giants

name: Gift of the Chromatic Dragon
description: Chromatic Infusion: once per long rest, as a bonus action, touch a simple or martial weapon so that for 1 minute it deals an extra 1d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison (your choice) on a hit. Reactive Resistance: when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison damage, use your reaction to resist that instance; proficiency bonus times per long rest.

name: Gift of the Gem Dragon
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Telekinetic Reprisal: when a creature within 10 feet damages you, use your reaction to force a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier): 2d8 force and pushed 10 feet, or half damage and no push on a success. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

name: Gift of the Metallic Dragon
description: Draconic Healing: learn cure wounds; cast it once per long rest without a slot, or with slots, using Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma (chosen with this feat). Protective Wings: when you or a creature you can see within 5 feet is hit by an attack, use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to its AC against that attack; proficiency bonus times per long rest.

name: Blade Barrier
description: When you use a twinblade's Whirl special bonus action, you also make one extra melee attack with it (d4 damage die, same ability modifier), and until the start of your next turn creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they enter your reach or make a melee attack against you within it.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Cat's Caress
description: After taking the Attack action with a claw in one hand, use a bonus action to make up to two melee attacks with a claw in your other hand (no ability modifier to damage unless negative or you have Two-Weapon Fighting). Advantage on claw attacks against a creature you are grappling. Equip or unequip one claw or a pair as an action or bonus action.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Fearsome Flourisher
description: When you take the Attack action with a nunchaku, use a bonus action to make one more melee attack with it (d4 damage die). When you take the Flourish special action with a nunchaku and don't fail the Dexterity check, a bonus action forces one creature in reach to make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Dexterity modifier, + proficiency bonus if proficient in Intimidation) or be frightened of you until the start of your next turn.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Scourge Master
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. When you hit with a whip or tetherhook, use a bonus action to try to disarm the target of a shield or held item (your Strength or Dexterity check contested by its Strength); it lands midway between you. You can pull items under 1 pound within your weapon's reach back to you.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Spray 'n' Pray
prerequisite: Proficiency with a magitech firearm or tommybow
description: Reload firearms and tommybows as an action or bonus action. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks. When you attack with a one-handed weapon, use a bonus action to attack with a one-handed firearm or tommybow you hold. After attacking with a tommybow or magitech firearm, use a bonus action to make one or two more ranged attacks with it (-5 to both if you make two; no ability modifier to damage unless negative).
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Expert Enchanter
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Double your proficiency bonus on Enchanting checks with proficient skills, adjust enchanting quirk rolls by up to half your proficiency bonus, and each hour of enchanting counts as 2 hours.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Expert Forger
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Double your proficiency bonus on Manufacturing checks with proficient tools, adjust enchanting and manufacturing quirk rolls by up to half your proficiency bonus, and each hour of forging counts as 2 hours.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Field Cook
description: Proficiency with cook's utensils. Replace one ingredient type in a recipe with any other. Before rolling quirks, you can replace one boon roll with inspiration for everyone who eats a portion. After rolling quirks, remove one flaw or add a rolled boon.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Forgemaster
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Advantage on Manufacturing checks with proficient tools, proficiency with two tools of your choice, and each hour of forging counts as 3 hours.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Jack of all Tools
description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Proficiency with three tools of your choice. Add half your proficiency bonus to Manufacturing checks with unproficient tools, without disadvantage. Each hour of manufacturing counts as 2 hours.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Weavebonder
description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Advantage on Enchanting checks with proficient skills; roll a quirk's random element twice and choose; each hour of enchanting counts as 3 hours.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Expert Harvester
description: +1 Dexterity or Intelligence. Double your proficiency bonus on Harvesting checks with proficient skills; add your proficiency bonus when you lack the required skill; add your full proficiency bonus when helping; no disadvantage for doing both Assessment and Carving alone.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Reapmaster
description: +1 Dexterity or Intelligence. Proficiency in Arcana, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Religion, or Survival, and advantage on Harvesting checks with proficient skills.
book: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1

name: Boomerang Expert
description: Boomerangs deal 1d8 for you, long range doesn't impose disadvantage with them, and you catch a thrown boomerang automatically.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Bumbling Fool
description: When you fail an ability check with a d20 roll at or below half your level (round up), replace the roll with 15. Three uses per long rest.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Canden and Moon's Master Cut
prerequisite: Beat a master at Master Canden and Moon's Sword School
description: +5 feet speed. After rolling initiative, use your reaction to draw a weapon, move half your speed, and make one melee attack if you end within reach. Once per long rest when hit, use your reaction for +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against that attack.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Cloud Hopper
description: While moving, step on conjured clouds through the air for up to 5 times your proficiency bonus feet per move (falling if you end aloft). Fog Cloud and Gust of Wind once each per long rest without a slot, or with slots (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Coven Witch
description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom. Learn two random common and uncommon potion recipes, and two 1st-level divination, conjuration, or transmutation spells, each castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Forager
description: +1 Wisdom. Proficiency in Survival (expertise if already proficient). Foraging yields twice the common or uncommon ingredients.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Freediver
description: +1 Constitution. Swim speed equal to twice your Constitution score (rounded up to 5 feet), or +10 feet if you already swim. Triple your Constitution modifier for holding your breath, and resistance to cold damage.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Group Combatant
description: Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage to you is reduced by 2 (minimum 1); flanking grants no advantage against you; after you provoke one opportunity attack on your turn, your movement provokes no more that turn.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Light Foot
description: +1 AC when not in heavy armor; forgo one attack of the Attack action to move half your speed; nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement; move through hostile creatures' spaces.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Magically Mischievous
description: Proficiency in Sleight of Hand (expertise if proficient). When you steal a palm-sized object with Sleight of Hand, make it invisible for 1 minute as by Obscure Object, proficiency bonus times per long rest.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Member of AHA
description: +1 Intelligence. You learn Jolt, plus Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Identify, or Illusory Script, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots (Intelligence).
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Minor Corruption
description: +1 AC while below half your hit points. You need no spellcasting focus or uncosted, unconsumed material components. Once per long rest, as a reaction negate up to three times your level in damage; at the end of your next turn and each turn for 1 minute make a Constitution save (DC 10 or a third of the damage, whichever is higher), taking the negated damage on the first failure.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Nakudama's Electric Bloodline
description: Resistance to lightning. Your tongue is a finesse, reach unarmed strike dealing 1d6 + Strength or Dexterity lightning (1d8 at 5th, 1d10 at 11th, 1d12 at 17th). When grappled, use your reaction to force a Constitution save (DC 8 + Con + proficiency bonus) or the grappler takes 1d10 lightning and the grapple ends.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Nakudama's Toxin Bloodline
description: Resistance to poison and advantage against being poisoned. As an action spit poison at up to proficiency bonus creatures within 30 feet: Constitution save (DC 8 + Con + proficiency bonus), 1d8 + proficiency bonus poison or half.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Postal Knight
description: +1 Constitution or Wisdom. Proficiency in Athletics and Survival, and exhaustion doesn't give you disadvantage on ability checks.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Potion Brewer
description: When brewing, you can use the second-highest ingredient attribute number instead of the first, and roll percentile dice: at or under your level, you make two potions.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Tellu and Scale's Master Cut
prerequisite: Beat a master at Master Tellu and Scale's Sword School
description: One-handed versatile weapon: once before your next turn when a creature in reach misses you with a melee attack, it takes damage equal to twice your proficiency bonus. Two-handed: when a creature in reach misses you with a melee weapon attack, use your reaction to force a Dexterity save (DC 8 + Strength + proficiency bonus) or it falls prone.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Toraf and Bolder's Master Cut
prerequisite: Beat a master at Master Toraf and Bolder's Sword School
description: Before a proficient melee weapon attack, take -5 to hit for a strike: Head (target has disadvantage on its next attack), Torso (it can't speak until your next turn, then immune for a minute), or Leg (-10 feet speed, minimum 10, until your next turn). One per attack.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Vocalist Arcanist
description: When a spell you cast calls for a save or a spell attack, make a Charisma (Performance) check against DC 10 + the spell's level (deciding after the roll); on a success your proficiency bonus is doubled for that attack roll or save DC. Three successes per dawn.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Wetland Explorer
description: Choose two creature types. Add your proficiency bonus to initiative when hostile creatures of those types are present, +5 to Stealth and Survival checks involving them, and +2 to attack rolls against them.
book: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass

name: Aerial Expert
description: No 10-foot run-up for long and high jumps, which can use Strength or Dexterity and double in distance. Dash while gliding to fly an extra distance equal to your speed, and change direction freely while gliding, gaining up to 10 feet of altitude once per descent.

name: Bandit Cunning
description: Once per long rest, use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to a saving throw. In combat, as an action make an Investigation check against DC 10 + the CR of a creature you've seen fight to learn one combat fact (a resistance or immunity, a condition immunity, a damaging or protective ability, an action option, or a special sense).

name: Heavy Glider
description: Glide while holding heavy weapons and wearing heavy armor if not encumbered. You can land a glide on a Large or smaller hostile creature: on a won Strength contest it is pushed 10 feet and knocked prone; otherwise you land nearby.

name: Opportunistic Thief
description: +1 Dexterity. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, a Sleight of Hand check against 10 + its Dexterity modifier steals an item it isn't holding or wearing. Out of combat, items you steal can be instantly concealed or swapped for another object.

name: Perfect Landing
description: +1 Dexterity. Fall damage uses d4s, you don't fall prone from falling damage, and you ignore the first 30 feet of a fall.

name: Speech of the Ancient Beasts
description: +1 Charisma. Large or larger beasts are friendly unless you attack them, you have advantage on Charisma checks against them, and you speak Giant Eagle, Giant Elk, and Giant Owl and can be understood by any Large or larger beast.

name: Woodwise
description: Proficiency in Survival or Nature, you ignore difficult terrain, and you can't become lost in nature except by magic.

name: Fate-Touched
description: Fortune's Grace: once per long rest, reroll your own attack roll, ability check, or save before the outcome is known, or force a creature you can see to reroll an attack against you or a save against your spell or feature (rerolling both dice if it had advantage or disadvantage).

name: Cruel
description: You have cruelty dice (d6) equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest, one per turn: add one to damage you deal, gain temporary hit points equal to one when you crit, or add one to an Intimidation check.

name: Flash Recall
prerequisite: Spellcasting feature from a class that prepares spells
description: Once per short or long rest as a bonus action, prepare a spell of 1st level or higher (of a level you have slots for) in place of a prepared spell of equal or higher level.

name: Mystic Conflux
description: You can attune to four magic items at once, and cast identify once per long rest without a slot or material components.

name: Remarkable Recovery
description: +1 Constitution. When stabilized while dying, regain hit points equal to your Constitution modifier, and regain that much extra whenever a spell, potion, or class feature heals you.

name: Spelldriver
prerequisite: Character level 11 or higher; Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
description: When you cast a 1st-level or higher spell as a bonus action, you can still cast another 1st-level or higher spell with your action, but only one spell that turn can be 3rd level or higher.

name: Thrown Arms Master
description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Simple and martial melee weapons gain the thrown property for you (one-handed 20/60, two-handed 15/30), existing thrown ranges improve by 20/40, and a missed thrown light weapon returns to your hand at the end of your turn.

name: Vital Sacrifice
description: As a bonus action, take 1d6 unreducible necrotic for a blood boon lasting 1 hour: spend it to add 1d6 to an attack roll, deal +2d6 necrotic on a hit, or subtract 1d4 from a creature's Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution save against you.
